carte.sans_contour: Boundaries for the administrative division redrawn on 20 August 2026 are not available in any reusable file. Territories are shown here as a grid, without geometry.

methodologie.dictionnaire_aide: {n} documented indicators. Each entry gives the formula, the unit, the data status and the interpretation pitfall.

limites_connues.texte: The Observatory currently only covers SIMANDOU SEJOUR's partner scope for activity and spend indicators. Its history is still short. Administrative compliance data depends on a transmission from the supervising authority that has not yet occurred. Fine-grained search geolocation is never published, only country-level origin is. No map outline is available: territorial representations are limited to centroids.

principes_generaux.texte: The Observatory answers three questions: what is the accommodation supply in Guinea, what is the expressed and declared demand, and where is the gap between the two. It never restitutes financial data of SIMANDOU SEJOUR, nominative data per establishment, or personal traveller data.

referentiel_territorial.texte: The administrative division was reorganised on 20 August 2026: 10 regions, 44 prefectures, about 366 communes. No public data source reflects this division yet; the geographic boundaries of the new regions and prefectures likely exist in no reusable file. The Observatory's reference is therefore versioned, with a mapping to the previous division.

regles_masquage.aide: Three rules, applied by the database and never recomputed by the application.
regles_masquage.m0: M0, raw volumes. Always displayed, whatever the sample size, including zero.
regles_masquage.m0_corps: Always displayed, whatever the count, including zero.
regles_masquage.m1: M1, confidentiality. A hotel performance aggregate is only displayed if the sample includes at least 3 establishments and none represents more than half of the units.
regles_masquage.m1_corps: A hotel performance aggregate is displayed only if the sample contains at least 3 establishments and none accounts for more than half the units.
regles_masquage.m2: M2, very small sample. Below 10 observations, a ratio is shown as counts, never as a percentage.
regles_masquage.m2_corps: Below 10 observations, a ratio is displayed as counts, never as a percentage.

methodologie.selectionner: Select an indicator to display its sheet.

sources_canaux.texte: Four channels feed the Observatory: the field survey conducted by SIMANDOU SEJOUR, institutional input by invited accounts, the booking platform feed, and administrative transmission by the competent authorities.

m1.ecart_admin_aide: Establishments listed by an administrative register and not found during field recording, or the reverse.
m1.qualite_inventaire_aide: What the Observatory knows about supply, and what it does not know yet.
m1.question: What accommodation supply exists in Guinea, of what kind, of what capacity, and what share of it is genuinely bookable online?
m1.repartition_gamme_aide: Declared price positioning, from budget to upscale.
m1.tableau_territorial_aide: Every region in the reference list, including those with no recorded establishment.
m1.territoires_repartition_aide: Density of recorded establishments, one tile per region.

m10.question: How each figure in the Observatory is produced, over what scope, with what reliability, and what it does not say.

m2.appareil_aide: Type of device used for the search.
m2.canal_aide: Entry channel of the search, in reference-list order.
m2.destinations_aide: Built on the destination entered, never on the origin of the connection.
m2.hors_referentiel_aide: Localities searched that match no territory in the reference list. Each rectangle is proportional to the number of searches.
m2.origine_aide: Top ten countries. No granularity below country level is published.
m2.part_filtre_budget: {p} of searches used the budget filter
m2.question: Who is looking to come to Guinea, from which country, to which destination, on what dates, for how long and on what budget.
m2.saisonnalite_aide: Searches by intended month of arrival, not by month of search.

m3.avertissement_perimetre: This module covers the partner scope only, that is {n} establishments. It does not describe the sector, it describes what is sold on the platform.
m3.conversion_aide: Both rates are placed on the same scale, never separately.
m3.conversion_lecture: A conversion rate read on its own reads as commercial underperformance. Read next to the platform coverage rate, it reads as a mechanical consequence of the share of stock that is genuinely bookable online.
m3.question: What actually happens across the commercialised scope: how many bookings, what occupancy rate, at what average price.
m3.reservations_par_mois_aide: Non-cancelled bookings, allocated to the month of arrival rather than of booking.

m7.decomposition_recenses: Recorded non-bookable: theoretical capacity, availability unknown

perimetre.avertissement: Market indicators cover the observed scope only and do not constitute exhaustive national statistics.
